nuggets.text: Rice-Eccles Stadium opened on Sept. 12, 1998, with a 45-22 win over Louisville, 28 years to the day before this game.
Rice-Eccles Stadium hosted the opening and closing ceremonies of the 2002 Winter Olympics.
Morgan Scalley played defensive back on Utah's unbeaten 2004 team, the first to bust the BCS, and now runs the Utes.
Morgan Scalley coached the Utes to a 44-22 win over Nebraska in the 2025 Las Vegas Bowl.
Devon Dampier was MVP of the 2025 Las Vegas Bowl after throwing for 310 yards and running for 148.
Devon Dampier's 34 total touchdowns in 2025 rank second in Utah history, behind only Alex Smith's 42 in 2004.
Wayshawn Parker had the first three-touchdown game of his career in the Utes' 66-14 win over Idaho.
Swoop, a red-tailed hawk, became the Utes' mascot in 1996 with the consent of the Ute tribal council.
The Utah Man fight song was written in 1904 by Harvey Holmes and the football team.
The Utes beat Nick Saban's Alabama 31-17 in the 2009 Sugar Bowl and finished No. 2 in the AP poll.
